messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Thompson <alyssa.thompson@lumenretail.com>
Date: 2027-03-14T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Rerank model fit: follow-up & evaluation plan

Hi Alyssa —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and the immediate next steps for the model-fit evaluation: 

What we discussed
- LumenRetail goal: improve relevance for merchandising and browse (reduce noisy top results for ambiguous queries) while keeping p95 latency under ~120ms.
- Current production metrics you shared: NDCG@10 ~0.412, MRR ~0.293 (served by your current hybrid heuristic).

Redwood action items (this thread)
1) Share the evaluation prompt set we used in the call (attached: prompt_set_v1.csv).
2) Share a short benchmark summary + per-model NDCG/MRR we ran on your sample (attached: benchmark_summary.pdf).
3) Propose an A/B/canary rollout plan and acceptance criteria below.

Recommended candidate models (shortlist)
- rw-rerank-v2 (6B quant, low-latency config) — best quality/cost tradeoff from our internal runs.
- openltr-3b-8bit — slightly smaller, faster; good if we need tighter latency budget.
- cross-encoder-small — fast, fallback option for tail queries.

Proposed quick A/B canary (tentative)
- Phase 0 (pilot): 10% traffic, 14 days, holdback comparison across NDCG/MRR and click metrics.
- Ramp: 10% -> 25% -> 50% if success criteria met.

Success criteria (initial)
- Point estimate: NDCG@10 uplift >= +0.03 vs baseline AND no statistically significant regression on navigational query CTRs.
- Latency: p95 path for rerank must remain <= 120ms (target).

Attachments: prompt_set_v1.csv, benchmark_summary.pdf (summary + per-query distributions). Full ndcg table will follow after we run the extended long-tail tests.

Next steps from you
- Confirm the pilot start window (you mentioned early April in the call).
- Share the contact for procurement / PO and the internal dataops owner for instrumentation (cc them if convenient).

I can schedule a 45-min tech deep-dive with Logan and Monica next week to go over instrumentation needs and the acceptance criteria if that helps.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai

Hi Alyssa —

Answers inline and a short data-backed note from our evals: 

1) Per-query distribution: attached ndcg_mrr_table.csv includes NDCG/MRR binned by query frequency (head: top 5% queries, mid: next 15%, tail: bottom 80%). Early signal: rw-rerank-v2 shows the largest absolute lift in mid-tail where noise was most common. We saw a +0.046 NDCG@10 lift vs your baseline on the sample set; openltr-3b was +0.034.

Summary numbers (sample eval)
- Baseline (your current): NDCG@10 = 0.412, MRR = 0.293
- rw-rerank-v2: NDCG@10 = 0.458 (+0.046), MRR = 0.321 (+0.028)
- openltr-3b-8bit: NDCG@10 = 0.446 (+0.034), MRR = 0.313 (+0.020)

2) Navigational queries: in our sample set rw-rerank-v2 had near-zero regression on single-token brand queries (measured CTR delta within noise). We'll include a dedicated navigational test set in the pilot to monitor that explicitly.

3) Cost delta: rough ballpark (cluster + inference): at 10% pilot we estimate ~ $120/day incremental; at 50% roughly $520/day. These are rough and depend on batching and cache settings — we will provide a more precise forecast after you share typical qps and average seq lengths.

Suggested A/B/canary plan (detailed)
- Pilot (2 weeks): 10% live traffic, compare against holdback; sample logs + join to clicks for offline NDCG.
- Ramp (if pilot passes): 10% -> 25% (7d) -> 50% (7d).
- Metrics: NDCG@10 uplift, MRR uplift, navigational CTR regression (guardrail), p95 latency.
- Rollback triggers: any measured navigational CTR regression > -1.5% absolute (stat sig), or p95 latency > 140ms sustained for >1h.

Instrumentation tags to add (suggested)
- rerank_model_variant (holdback|rw-v2|openltr-3b)
- experiment_id (LUM-rerank-2027-03)
- query_bucket (head|mid|tail) — if you can add on the dataops side we’ll ingest it to slice results.

I've attached ndcg_mrr_table.csv and reattached prompt_set_v1.csv. I've also dropped a link to an eval folder with per-query PDFs and the short playbook we use for ramping (rerank_playbook_v1.md).

If that looks good, I'll ask Logan to run a short infra checklist with your dataops for early April. We can also schedule the tech deep-dive (45m) — when is the best window for you?

Thanks —
Stephanie

Internal note — adding a short ops checklist and risk mitigations before we start pilot. Forwarding the thread for context.

Key ops/risks
- Long-tail behavior: request A/B sample of 500 lowest-frequency queries for manual review (we should pick a stratified sample by shard).
- Quantization jitter: rw-rerank-v2 quant path has small variability on some embeddings; recommend one-week internal soak on staging with quantized kernel before pilot.
- Latency path: ensure KV-cache warmup and consistent batching on p95 path; set the model timeout to 300ms at the gateway to avoid noisy errors.
- Telemetry: create dashboard tiles for NDCG@10 by query_bucket, p95 latency per route, and navigational CTR. Add an alert if navigational CTR drops by >1% absolute over 2h.

Ramp schedule suggestion (ops-driven)
- Week 0 (pilot): 10% live, monitor aggressively (daily check-ins).
- Week 2: if no regressions, increase to 25% for one week.
- Week 3: 50% while keeping holdback until 50% pass.

Deliverables before pilot
- Staging soak of quantized model (internal)
- Dashboard and alerts provisioned (we can help with dashboard templates)
- Manual review sample prepared by LumenRetail dataops

Attaching: rerank_playbook_v1.md (playbook + rollback steps).

Thanks —
Logan
Head of Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.ai
